Welcome—I'm so glad you're here with me.
Imagine a journey that weaves together loss, hope, and those unexpected moments when love completely changes the course of our lives. That's exactly what unfolds in the world of Finding Chika: A Little Girl, an Earthquake, and the Making of a Family, beautifully written by Mitch Albom.
Together, we're going to step into the aftermath of the earthquake in Haiti, where life feels fragile but the human spirit shines with resilience. At the center of this story is Chika—a bright, spirited little girl whose presence doesn't just touch hearts, but really transforms the very idea of family, belonging, and caring for one another.
As we follow her journey through illness and the search for healing, we'll discover the deep connections that can form between people from completely different worlds. It's a story that asks us: What does it mean to truly open your heart, even when joy and sorrow walk hand in hand?
As we move forward, you'll notice how the roles of caregiver and child, teacher and student, start to blur in the most unexpected ways. Nurturing Chika isn't just about helping her—it becomes a way to reflect on what family really means, how deep compassion can go, and how loss can shape us in ways we never imagined.
Mitch Albom invites us to look closely at how love can be both painful and powerful—a source of strength when we need it most.
So, as we explore this emotional landscape together, let's open ourselves to the lessons found in both joy and grief, and discover just how transformative human connection can be.
